# DEGREE 14, DIAMETER 4: 9,720 VERTICES
# -------------------------------------
# 9,720 vertices, 68,040 undirected edges, every vertex of degree 14, every pair of vertices within 4
# steps of each other.
#
# Route-chart lift: the controller is Cay(SL(2,3) x Z_5; a, b, p) on 120 vertices, the fibre F_3^4;
# (v, x) is joined to (t(v), M_t x + lambda d_t) for t = a, a^-1, b, b^-1 and lambda in F_3, and to
# (p(v), -x + c_p) and (p^-1(v), -x + c_p) (charts in construction.json).
#
# Vertex 81 v + x0 + 3 x1 + 9 x2 + 27 x3 is the pair (v, x), v = 5 k + i the group element (X_k, i)
# with X_0 = I and X_1..X_23 the other matrices of determinant 1 in lexicographic order.
#
# One edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered 0..9719; README.md describes the construction.
